The '''2026 Milton Keynes City Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect all 60 members of [[Milton Keynes City Council]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elections on 7 May 2026 {{!}} Milton Keynes City Council |url=https://www.milton-keynes.gov.uk/your-council-and-elections/elections-and-register-vote/elections-7-may-2026 |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=www.milton-keynes.gov.uk}}</ref> The whole council was up for election on new ward boundaries, with the number of seats increasing by 3 to 60.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Crook |first=Charles |date=2024-12-03 |title=MK City Council confirm review of cities' boundaries and proposal of extra councillors |url=https://citiblog.co.uk/2024/12/03/mk-city-council-confirm-review-of-cities-boundaries-and-proposal-of-extra-councillors/ |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=CitiBlog |language=en}}</ref>

== Background ==
In [[2024 Milton Keynes City Council election|2024]], Labour retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Milton Keynes result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E06000042 |access-date=2026-01-27 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Changes 2024–2026:
*August 2024: [[Emily Darlington]] (Labour) resigns – by-election held September 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Murrer |first1=Sally |title=Newly-elected Milton Keynes Labour MP stands down her role at our city council |url=https://www.miltonkeynes.co.uk/news/politics/newly-elected-milton-keynes-labour-mp-stands-down-from-city-council-4725463 |access-date=2 February 2026 |work=Milton Keynes Citizen |date=1 August 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
*September 2024: 
**Saskia Soden (Labour) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Bletchley East Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/12801/#2024-09-12 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=2 February 2026}}</ref>
**Robin Bradburn (Liberal Democrats) dies – by-election held November 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Issimdar |first1=Mariam |title=Milton Keynes council group leader dies at Lib Dem conference |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c4gqqwlyly7o |access-date=2 February 2026 |work=BBC News |date=15 September 2024}}</ref>
*October 2024: Kerrie Bradburn (Liberal Democrats) resigns – by-election held November 2024<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Super Thursday results special |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2024/10/super-thursday-results-special/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=2 February 2026}}</ref>
*November 2024: Kerrie Bradburn (Liberal Democrats){{efn|Kerrie Bradburn is Robin Bradburn's daughter, and resigned her seat in Broughton to contest the Bradwell by-election.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Teale |first1=Andrew |title=Previewing the 12 local by-elections of 14th November 2024 |url=https://andrewspreviews.substack.com/p/previewing-the-12-local-by-elections?has_completed_unsubscribed_unlock=true |access-date=2 February 2026}}</ref>}} and Clare Tevlin (Liberal Democrats) win by-elections<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Broughton Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/12805/#2024-11-14 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=2 February 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Bradwell Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/12804/#2024-11-14 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=2 February 2026}}</ref>
